name: The Deathstalkers
label: Quest
description: This task marks the trial for initiates seeking entry into the Deathstalkers, the covert and lethal arm answering to Lord Varimathras in the Undercity.…
intro: This task marks the trial for initiates seeking entry into the Deathstalkers, the covert and lethal arm answering to Lord Varimathras in the Undercity. Assigned by Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter, the mission demands ruthless initiative to intercept a traveling messenger. Completing it opens the door to deeper clandestine schemes within the Forsaken realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, Lord Varimathras' elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.
I will not lie to you, friend, this task could mean your death.

I have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.
It will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You've passed the first part of this test. Hopefully Andron will not have caught wind of your activities, and we will be able to convince him that you are, in fact, the messenger he is expecting.
